rule: one static camera view within one sequence, i.e. (sequence, camera). 175 of them in the camera experiments.
a repeated observation of that view, NOT an independent sample. 1400 frames means 175 views x 8 frames.
physical camera id (40) and sequence (5), used to check that results survive correlated structure. Five clusters is a sensitivity check, not a trustworthy confidence interval.

these are different and must not be conflated. The bias/noise decomposition is computed over the (sequence, camera) STATIC VIEW, with frames as repeated observations inside it - so its output is a between-view component, not a physical-camera-level bias. Physical camera and sequence are RESAMPLING units, used only to widen confidence intervals in the CAM-EXP-004.1 robustness check.
a reference / self-consistency target, not an independent external ground truth.
dataset-provided 2D observations with confidence, not curated GT. An all-zero (0,0) entry is an observed invalid pattern, not a documented sentinel.
identical input frames for every model, from a manifest frozen before inference.
logged with a reason, never silently removed.
anything that uses the ground truth (GT-undistorted images, oracle best-of-N frame choice) is a diagnostic and is never reported as a deployable method.
never across sequences: a deployment calibrates one video at a time.
leave-one-sequence-out; selection may only see the four training-fold sequences, and all five held-out numbers are reported.
a sealed external dataset, evaluated once, after method development is finished.
exact repository commits and checkpoint SHA256 recorded for every external model; GeoCalib is known to vary between runs and its numbers carry a ~+/-0.35 pp tolerance.
